elements.name: Swing GUI screens
elements.responsibility: Ten Swing windows (home, login, registration, dashboard, report creation, report lists, status update, internal notes, monitoring); collect input and show results

elements.name: Services facade
elements.responsibility: SystemServicesController: single entry point for the GUIs, creates and delegates to the use-case controllers, turns exceptions into boolean results

elements.name: Use-case controllers
elements.responsibility: One controller per use case (registration, login, report creation, review, details, status update, internal note, monitoring, notification)

elements.name: Report and user services
elements.responsibility: ReportService and UserService: business rules for reports, users, status changes, notes, notifications and monitoring; return data as maps

elements.name: Domain entities
elements.responsibility: User (Citizen, MunicipalOperator), Report with state classes, Location, StatusUpdate, InternalNote, Notification, Credentials, ReportCategory; JPA-annotated

elements.name: Persistence service
elements.responsibility: PersistenceService (generic save, update, find-by-attribute) over JpaUtil, which owns the JPA EntityManagerFactory (Hibernate)

elements.name: MySQL reports_db
elements.responsibility: External relational store reached over JDBC through Hibernate

elements.name: Boundary package (presentation)
elements.responsibility: Java package holding the Swing GUI screens

elements.name: Control package (application logic)
elements.responsibility: Java package holding the facade and use-case controllers

elements.name: Entity package (domain and domain services)
elements.responsibility: Java package holding entities and also ReportService/UserService

elements.name: Database package (persistence)
elements.responsibility: Java package holding PersistenceService and JpaUtil

elements.name: Services API
elements.responsibility: Public operations of SystemServicesController (register, create, review, details, status update, note, monitoring); data passed as Map<String,Object>

concern_details.detail: main architectural components and their responsibilities
separation of UI, application logic, domain entities and persistence, and how they collaborate
